papers.title: The Tasteful Agent: Measuring and Improving Taste in Long-Horizon Tasks
papers.desc: LLM agents increasingly work on long-horizon tasks, and the decisions they make along the way, such as which hypothesis to test or which implementation to build on, determine the outcome of the whole run.

papers.title: All-in-One Multilingual Scene Text Recognition with Script-aware Mixture-of-Experts
papers.desc: Multilingual scene text recognition (STR) remains challenging due to the scarcity of training data for most languages and the difficulty of serving diverse scripts within a single model.

papers.title: StableVQ: Practical Guidelines for Stable Vector-Quantized Tokenizer Training
papers.desc: Vector Quantization (VQ) is fundamental to discrete visual tokenizers that power modern autoregressive and masked image generation models.

papers.title: Lean Pool: An AI-Maintained Archive of Formalized Mathematics
papers.desc: Lean Pool is a repository of formalized mathematics.

papers.title: JEV-as-a-Judge: Accept When Confident, Escalate When Unsure
papers.desc: LLM-as-a-judge enables evaluation across diverse tasks, but inference cost and confidence reliability become critical at scale.

papers.title: Agensh: Scaling Organizational Intelligence to 1,024 Agents
papers.desc: A multi-agent system can reduce latency on complex tasks by executing work concurrently.

papers.title: Emergent Collusion in Long-Horizon LLM Agent Interaction
papers.desc: LLM agents are increasingly deployed in collaborative settings, yet long-term interaction may give rise to undesirable coordination.

papers.title: Blaming Across the Aisle: Political Contrasting and Blame Attribution in the Danish Parliament
papers.desc: Political discourse is widely perceived to be growing more hostile, yet robust evidence remains scarce.

papers.title: LatentPort: Beyond KV Cache - Cross-Model Transfer of Recurrent Memory in Hybrid Language Models: A 4B-to-9B Hybrid-State Handoff Without Target Prefix Replay
papers.desc: Can one language model hand its live memory to another without the receiver rereading the context? We demonstrate useful persistent hybrid-state transfer across one architecture-matched Qwen3.5 4B-to-9B sibling pair.

papers.title: RoboFollow: Unveiling the Instruction Following Mirage in Embodied Agents
papers.desc: Modern embodied agents achieve impressive success rates, yet their actual instruction-following ability is far weaker than these numbers suggest.

papers.title: Geometric and Semantic Coupling for Interaction Understanding in 3D Scenes
papers.desc: Interaction understanding in 3D scenes requires a joint description of movable parts, their motion, and the regions through which they can be operated.

papers.title: ImIR: Image-Instruction Tuning for All-in-One Image Restoration
papers.desc: Degradations vary widely across images, so a practical restoration system has to handle many degradation types with one model.

papers.title: Tri-PvP: Exposing Modality Bias in Omni-Modal Large Language Models through Perceptual-Propositional Evidence Conflicts
papers.desc: Omni-modal large language models (OLLMs) jointly process vision, audio, and text, yet their modality bias under cross-modal conflict remains underexplored.

papers.title: Embedding Physics Priors in Robot Learning: A Survey
papers.desc: The rapid progress of artificial intelligence is reshaping robotics and accelerating the adoption of learning-based approaches.

papers.title: ALPINE: Adaptive Localization for Parameter- and Sample-Efficient Few-Shot Learning
papers.desc: Few-shot learning research is predominantly evaluated on accuracy alone, with limited attention to the parameter and training-sample budgets required to reach that accuracy - a real constraint for practitioners without large-scale compute.
